items.title: Jake Ferguson: Could practice Friday
items.text:
Head coach Brian Schottenheimer hopes that Ferguson (ankle) will be "back on the field" Friday, Tommy Yarrish of the Cowboys' official site reports.

        Visit RotoWire.com for more analysis on this update.

items.title: George Pickens: Will remain limited Friday
items.text:
Pickens (hamstring) "will be a little bit limited" Friday, but head coach Brian Schottenheimer is "hopeful" he will play Sunday against the Colts, Tommy Yarrish of the Cowboys' official site reports.

        Visit RotoWire.com for more analysis on this update.

items.title: Cam Skattebo: Seemingly out for Week 9
items.text:
"It does not seem" that Skattebo (hamstring) will play Sunday against the Eagles, Ian Rapoport of NFL Network reports.

        Visit RotoWire.com for more analysis on this update.

items.title: Breece Hall: Expected to play Sunday
items.text:
Hall (quadriceps) "has been medically cleared" and is expected to play Sunday against the Chiefs, Ian Rapoport of NFL Network reports.

        Visit RotoWire.com for more analysis on this update.

items.title: Deshaun Watson: Unlikely to start Sunday
items.text:
Watson (concussion) "is unlikely to start" Sunday's game against the Saints, Ian Rapoport of NFL Network reports.

        Visit RotoWire.com for more analysis on this update.
